headline: Genmab Shares Fall 3% After Q3 Revenue Misses Estimates
summary: Genmab shares dropped 3% following third-quarter revenue results that fell slightly short of market expectations.
why: Revenue misses relative to consensus forecasts directly impact equity valuations in the biotechnology sector.

impacts.name: Genmab A/S
impacts.why: Lower-than-expected revenue figures trigger negative revisions and immediate stock sell-offs.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Disappointing financial results relative to expectations reduce projected earnings growth, prompting downward valuation adjustments.
